Minecraft runtime dependencies are installed from the exact npm lockfile. Mineflayer
(PrismarineJS, https://github.com/PrismarineJS/mineflayer) and mineflayer-pathfinder
(https://github.com/PrismarineJS/mineflayer-pathfinder) are MIT licensed. Their full
license texts and dependency notices remain in the installed node_modules packages.

Minecraft is a Mojang/Microsoft product. Game binaries are downloaded separately,
verified against the frozen SHA-256, and never redistributed in this repository.
The runtime requires explicit EULA acceptance in its launch configuration.
